items.desc: Shafaq News- Al-Sulaymaniyah A major fire destroyed a gasoline warehouse in the Tanjaro area of Al-Sulaymaniyah on Saturday, Deputy Governor Shaho Othman told Shafaq News. Civil Defense spokesperson Aram Ali said preliminary findings suggested the fire started during fuel unloading at the facility.
